messages:
ravi: Hey team — flagging a confusing discrepancy: console rollup p95 for /v1/embeddings is ~12ms LOWER than the endpoint p95 for the same hour. Charts label rollup as p95 but endpoint shows raw p95. Anyone know why rollup would under-report tail?

lina: We switched rollups to an approximate quantiles algorithm (GK) to save space. Endpoint p95 is computed from raw samples (exact). The GK merge can under-estimate tail when centroids are coarse or sample distribution shifts.

jamal: That explains it. Approx quantiles are great for overview but dangerous for SLOs where the tail matters. Also if sample_count is low the approximation error increases.

ravi: Ops impact: customers viewing the console might think latency improved and reduce alerting sensitivity. We had an incident last quarter where UI metrics hid a tail regression.

tess: UX ask: console should show the quantile method and raw sample count next to the percentile tile. A small badge like: [p95 · approx(GK) · 2.1k samples]. Click to compare endpoint/exact.

oncall-jen: Important: our SLO evaluation pipeline uses endpoint/exact numbers (good), but theres a mismatch between what alerts people glance at and what actually gates rollouts. That mismatch is the root cause of confusion.

jamal: Short-term mitigation: add metadata to rollup points: rollup.quantile_method and rollup.sample_count. Console can default to showing a warning when quantile_method != "exact" and sample_count < 500 for p95/p99.

lina: Longer-term: we can enable exact quantile computation for routes that have SLOs (flagged in product config). That will increase storage/compute but keep correctness for critical endpoints.

ravi: Also propose a query param for the console route view: `?prefer=endpoint` that switches the tile to show endpoint numbers by default when possible. Helps reduce surprise when users drill into a single route.

jamal: Minimal server change: emit two small fields in rollup metadata (method, count). UI change: pill + tooltip + feature flag. Dev effort small and reversible.

deploy-bot: :warning: deploy scheduled 2026-04-01T12:00Z add-rollup-quantile-meta (id: aggr-4999)

tess: I'll prototype the badge and the prefer=endpoint toggle behind a feature flag. I'll include copy for the tooltip: "Rollup uses approximate quantiles (GK). Tail estimates may be noisy; click to show endpoint exacts."

lina: I'll add server tests to validate GK error bounds and a switch to compute exacts for SLO routes.

ravi: Thanks — once the metadata is emitted we can run a quick audit to find routes where approximate rollup and endpoint differ > 10% at p95/p99. I'll open a follow-up ticket for that audit.

jamal: Agreed. Also add a short runbook for oncall: if a user reports discrepancy, check rollup.quantile_method and sample_count, run endpoint vs rollup diff query:
```sql
SELECT hour, rollup.p95 AS rollup_p95, endpoint.p95 AS endpoint_p95, rollup.sample_count
FROM latency_rollups rollup
JOIN latency_endpoints endpoint USING(route, hour)
WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-30T11:00' AND '2026-03-30T12:00'
```

-- end of thread --
